task: Extract company, date, address and total from the actual scanned receipt image; emit UTF-8 structured answers and an image with predicted field boxes
source_allocation: First 6 distinct normalized annotated merchant strings in train rows 0:100 for fit, then first 12 previously unseen strings in test rows 0:100; reject exact image-hash duplicates
gate_feature: Mean recognized-word Tesseract confidence from actual base OCR; no reference text or reference boxes
gate_rule: Run enhanced OCR when base confidence is below fitted threshold and use the enhanced result; otherwise stop with base result
fit_objective: Mean four-field exact-match fraction minus 0.01 times actual fit wall seconds; maximize, lower threshold tie break
parser: Frozen layout/text rules using recognized text and OCR boxes only; no reference transcription or entity boxes during inference
normalization: Uppercase and retain only ASCII letters/digits for company/date/address; decimal numeric normalization for total when parseable
test_order: Rotate arm execution order by document index
reference_visibility: Reference entity dictionary enters scorer only after output JSON and predicted-box PNG are written and independently read back
input_output: Real scanned receipts and their corresponding original annotations; no unrelated audio/video pairing
training: Only a one-dimensional continuation threshold is fitted; Tesseract model and parser remain frozen
limits: OCR and rule-based document information extraction, not a multimodal LLM or complex general image-text reasoning; twelve test documents and normalized merchant groups only
stopping_rule: One fixed fit/test collection; retain missing fields, wrong fields, failures and extra-compute regressions without test-set retuning
